_comment: TEMPORARY TEST DATA for developing the A5 report layout. Replace with Alibek's tests/fixtures/state_v1_S1.json when available. ACME facts come from the KB files (cited by ID). The incident (U-01) is the scenario example from PROJECT.md section 4. claims.text: A PCX-100 unit emitted smoke while charging a laptop

claims.text: By 22 Oct 2026, 11,000 PCX-100 units from batches PCX-2609-A and PCX-2609-B had been delivered to channels in DE, IT and FR, and 5,000 were in the Frankfurt warehouse
In September 2026, 18 of 420 PowerCharge X support tickets were about perceived heat; 16 were closed without reproducing a defect and 2 were awaiting samples on 22 Oct
The July 2026 VN-3 visit shows the September batches are fine

narrative.executive_summary: An unconfirmed social post reports smoke from a PCX-100 charger [C-001, U-01]. Risk is High because of the safety floor F1, with low evidence confidence. Priority actions: obtain the unit for Quality [ACT-001], hold the September batches [ACT-002] and acknowledge the post [ACT-003].
narrative.situation: A TownSquare post shows a PCX-100 that reportedly emitted smoke while charging a laptop [C-001, U-01]. The report is unconfirmed: there is no link, serial number or sample yet. 11,000 units from batches PCX-2609-A/B are in channels and 5,000 are in the Frankfurt warehouse [C-002, KB-13]. The July VN-3 visit did not cover September batches [C-004, KB-11].
